blocks.zh: Section 5 Introduction to Reworking 返工概論
blocks.en: Section 5 Introduction to Reworking

blocks.zh: 本章 Part B 學習目標
blocks.en: Part B Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 Post-Approval Change (PAC) 的六大決策工具，並能應用 Table 5.6-1 框架評估返工文件完整性。
blocks.en: Understand the six decision tools for a Post-Approval Change (PAC) and apply the Table 5.6-1 framework to assess the completeness of rework documentation.

blocks.zh: 說明 ICH Q12 引入的 Established Conditions (EC) 概念如何改變返工事件的監管申報邏輯。
blocks.en: Explain how the Established Conditions (EC) concept introduced by ICH Q12 changes the regulatory filing logic for rework events.

blocks.zh: 掌握 Post-Approval Change Management Protocol (PACMP) 與 Comparability Protocol 的關係，以及 CDMO 如何為 Sponsor 準備此類文件。
blocks.en: Understand the relationship between a Post-Approval Change Management Protocol (PACMP) and a Comparability Protocol, and how a CDMO prepares these documents for the Sponsor.

blocks.zh: 辨別返工過程中蛋白質不穩定的化學性與物理性根因，並了解 CQA 偏差 vs 分析方法干擾的鑑別原則。
blocks.en: Identify the chemical and physical root causes of protein instability during rework, and understand the principles for distinguishing a true CQA deviation from analytical method interference.

blocks.zh: 說明跨部門溝通計畫的關鍵要素（5.10.1 角色、5.10.2 溝通），以及台灣 CDMO 在 TFDA + US FDA + 歐盟三轄區同步申報的現實挑戰。
blocks.en: Explain the key elements of a cross-functional communication plan (5.10.1 roles, 5.10.2 communication), and the practical challenge for a Taiwan CDMO of filing in parallel with TFDA, US FDA and the EU.

blocks.zh: 列出典型返工時程的六個階段（共 6–12 個月），並能識別 CBE-30 vs PAS vs EU Type II Variation 的差異。
blocks.en: List the six phases of a typical rework timeline (6-12 months in total) and identify the differences between CBE-30, PAS and EU Type II Variation.

blocks.zh: 說明品質部門在返工「事前把關」與「執行期間監督」的雙重角色，以及需要預先準備的文件清單。
blocks.en: Explain the Quality Unit's dual role of pre-approval gating and oversight during execution of a rework, and the documents that must be prepared in advance.

blocks.zh: 5.6 Post-Approval Change Tools 上市後變更決策工具
blocks.en: 5.6 Post-Approval Change Tools

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Post-Approval Change (PAC，上市後變更): 任何在上市核准後對已核准製程、規格、設施或其他 CMC 要素的更動，均屬 PAC。返工本質上就是一種非預期的 PAC——它並非計畫性變更，而是因 OOS 觸發的緊急製程調整。
blocks.en: Post-Approval Change (PAC): Any change made after marketing approval to the approved process, specifications, facility or other CMC elements is a PAC. A rework is essentially an unplanned PAC: it is not a planned change but an urgent process adjustment triggered by an OOS.

blocks.zh: Table 5.6-1 六大決策維度:
blocks.en: The six decision dimensions of Table 5.6-1:

blocks.zh: Defining the Scope：明確變更背景與範圍
blocks.en: Defining the Scope: clarify the background and scope of the change

blocks.zh: Understanding Risk Assessment：CQA/CPP/EC 是否受影響
blocks.en: Understanding Risk Assessment: whether CQAs/CPPs/ECs are affected

blocks.zh: Regulatory Assessment：風險高低決定申報類別
blocks.en: Regulatory Assessment: the level of risk determines the filing category

blocks.zh: Definition / Approval Strategy：Design space 與 PACMP
blocks.en: Definition / Approval Strategy: design space and PACMP

blocks.zh: Implementation Process：驗證、送件、報告
blocks.en: Implementation Process: validation, submission, reporting

blocks.zh: Tools：商業案例、QRM、核准策略
blocks.en: Tools: business case, QRM, approval strategy

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: Table 5.6-1 就像一份「建築工程變更申請書」的標準格式——建築師不能只說「我想改樓梯位置」，必須說明為什麼改、結構強度評估、主管機關許可條件、施工計畫、竣工驗收。少任何一欄，申請就退件。PAC 也是相同邏輯。
blocks.en: Table 5.6-1 is like the standard form of a "building change application". An architect cannot simply say "I want to move the staircase"; they must explain why, provide a structural strength assessment, state the permit conditions of the authority, and give a construction plan and completion inspection. If any column is missing, the application is rejected. PAC follows the same logic.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: FDA + EMA 聯合工具箱 (2018): EMA 與 FDA 在 2018 年 11 月正式認可共同監管工具框架，代表跨轄區申報策略可以趨同——對台灣 CDMO 而言，此框架提供了可依循的雙邊對齊基礎。然而 TFDA 尚未正式採納 ICH Q12，需確認本地規範的對應要求。
blocks.en: FDA + EMA joint toolbox (2018): In November 2018 the EMA and FDA formally recognized a common regulatory tool framework, which means cross-jurisdiction filing strategies can converge. For a Taiwan CDMO, this framework offers a basis for bilateral alignment. However, the TFDA has not yet formally adopted ICH Q12, so the corresponding local requirements must be confirmed.

blocks.zh: TR91 交叉參考: PDA TR74 §5.6 明確指向 PDA TR91 (Post-Approval Change Management and Implementation for Biologics)——完整 PAC 實務請參照 TR91。
blocks.en: TR91 cross-reference: PDA TR74 §5.6 points explicitly to PDA TR91 (Post-Approval Change Management and Implementation for Biologics). See TR91 for complete PAC practice.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: Table 5.6-1 的「Risk Assessment」欄位中，什麼情況下風險被評為「high」、須走 Prior Approval Submission？
blocks.en: In the "Risk Assessment" column of Table 5.6-1, under what circumstances is the risk rated "high", requiring a Prior Approval Submission?

blocks.zh: 若一間台灣 CDMO 尚未在 BLA 中建立 Established Conditions，它能否直接使用 PACMP 流程？請說明原因。
blocks.en: If a Taiwan CDMO has not yet established Established Conditions in the BLA, can it use the PACMP process directly? Explain why.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application — CDMO 角度
blocks.en: Practical Application: CDMO Perspective

blocks.zh: 你的美國 Sponsor 要求 CDMO 提交完整的 Table 5.6-1 六欄自評表作為 Tech Transfer Package 的一部分。身為 OE Manager，你需協調 MS&T（製程理解）、RA（申報策略）、QA（EC 認定）三個部門各自填具後彙整。建立一份以 Table 5.6-1 欄位為骨幹的跨部門 SOP 是最有效的準備方式。
blocks.en: Your US Sponsor asks the CDMO to submit a completed six-column Table 5.6-1 self-assessment as part of the Tech Transfer Package. As OE Manager, you need to coordinate MS&T (process understanding), RA (filing strategy) and QA (EC determination), each completing their part, and then consolidate the results. Building a cross-functional SOP based on the Table 5.6-1 columns is the most effective way to prepare.

blocks.zh: Table 5.6-1 解讀要點
blocks.en: Key Points for Reading Table 5.6-1

blocks.zh: 左至右 = 從問題到行動的決策流：先定義範圍 → 評估風險 → 確認監管類別 → 設計核准策略 → 執行實施。每一欄的輸出是下一欄的輸入。
blocks.en: Left to right = the decision flow from problem to action: define the scope, assess the risk, confirm the regulatory category, design the approval strategy, then implement. The output of each column is the input to the next.

blocks.zh: 「EC 是否已建立」是關鍵分水嶺：若已建立 EC 且變更不影響任何 EC，可能僅需 PQS 內部管理；若 EC 受影響，則必須走正式申報。這是 ICH Q12 帶來的最大紅利——降低低風險變更的監管負擔。
blocks.en: "Whether ECs are established" is the key watershed: If ECs are established and the change affects none of them, it may only need to be managed internally within the PQS; if an EC is affected, a formal regulatory filing is required. This is the biggest benefit ICH Q12 brings: reducing the regulatory burden of low-risk changes.

blocks.zh: CDMO 現實檢核：若你的 BLA（生物製品許可申請）尚未建立 EC 清單，則 Table 5.6-1 第三欄的「Q12 PAC procedure」路徑實際上無法使用。此時所有重大變更都預設走 PAS（Prior Approval Supplement）。
blocks.en: CDMO reality check: If your BLA (Biologics License Application) has no EC list, the "Q12 PAC procedure" path in the third column of Table 5.6-1 is in practice not available. In that case all significant changes default to a PAS (Prior Approval Supplement).

blocks.zh: 決策層級提醒：無菌保證 > CQA 保護 > 商業彈性。當申報策略影響患者安全時，絕不以時程壓力妥協。
blocks.en: Reminder on the decision hierarchy: sterility assurance > CQA protection > commercial flexibility. When the filing strategy affects patient safety, never compromise it because of schedule pressure.

blocks.zh: 5.7 Established Conditions 既定條件
blocks.en: 5.7 Established Conditions

blocks.zh: Established Conditions (EC，既定條件): ICH Q12 定義的 EC 是「MAH 向主管機關申報、且被核准後必須維持不變的 CMC 要素清單」。只有寫進 EC 清單的參數或屬性，才需在變更時走正式監管申報。
blocks.en: Established Conditions (EC): As defined in ICH Q12, ECs are "the list of CMC elements that the MAH has filed with the regulatory authority and that must remain unchanged after approval". Only the parameters or attributes written into the EC list require a formal regulatory filing when changed.

blocks.zh: EC（需申報）：例如最終滅菌過濾器孔徑、某關鍵色譜管柱品牌/型號
blocks.en: EC (filing required): for example, the pore size of the terminal sterilizing filter, or the brand/model of a critical chromatography column

blocks.zh: Non-EC（可 PQS 內管理）：例如非關鍵緩衝液配製順序、輔助性清洗步驟
blocks.en: Non-EC (can be managed within the PQS): for example, the preparation order of a non-critical buffer, or a supportive cleaning step

blocks.zh: EC 的三大組成： CPP（關鍵製程參數）、CMA（關鍵物料屬性）、CQA（關鍵品質屬性）——均源自 ICH Q8(R2) 的 QbD 架構。
blocks.en: The three components of an EC: CPP (critical process parameters), CMA (critical material attributes) and CQA (critical quality attributes), all derived from the QbD framework of ICH Q8(R2).

blocks.zh: EC 就像一棟建築的「結構圖說」——已向政府主管機關申報備案的樑柱位置、承重牆位置都是 EC。想要移動這些元素，必須重新申請建照（監管申報）。但室內裝潢、油漆顏色就是 Non-EC，屋主自行決定即可，只需留存紀錄。
blocks.en: ECs are like the "structural drawings" of a building: the positions of beams, columns and load-bearing walls that have been filed with the government authority are all ECs. To move any of these elements, you must reapply for a building permit (regulatory filing). Interior decoration and paint color, however, are Non-ECs: the owner decides, and only needs to keep a record.

blocks.zh: 返工就像發現建築有結構偏差——要確認修繕方案是否動到備案的結構圖（EC），動到就必須向主管機關報告。
blocks.en: A rework is like discovering a structural deviation in the building. You must confirm whether the repair plan touches the filed structural drawings (ECs), and if it does, you must report to the authority.

blocks.zh: ICH Q12 的革命性意義： 在 Q12 之前，幾乎所有重大製程變更都需要 PAS（Prior Approval Supplement），等待時間 6–12 個月。Q12 的 EC 框架讓「不影響 EC 的變更」可以走 CBE-30 甚至 PQS 內管理，大幅縮短時程。
blocks.en: The revolutionary significance of ICH Q12: Before Q12, almost every significant process change required a PAS (Prior Approval Supplement), with a waiting time of 6-12 months. The EC framework of Q12 allows "changes that do not affect ECs" to go through CBE-30 or even be managed within the PQS, greatly shortening timelines.

blocks.zh: 台灣 CDMO 的現實挑戰： TFDA 在 2024 年以前尚未正式採納 ICH Q12。若 BLA 是美國 FDA 核准的，美國 Sponsor 期待 PACMP/EC 框架；但若同時在台灣生產供台灣市場，TFDA 可能仍要求走傳統 Type II variation 等效流程。建議與 Sponsor 的 RA 部門建立雙軌申報策略，而非單純複製美國申請。
blocks.en: Practical challenge for Taiwan CDMOs: Before 2024, the TFDA had not formally adopted ICH Q12. If the BLA was approved by the US FDA, the US Sponsor expects a PACMP/EC framework; but if product is also manufactured in Taiwan for the Taiwan market, the TFDA may still require the equivalent of the traditional Type II variation process. It is advisable to build a dual-track filing strategy with the Sponsor's RA department rather than simply copying the US application.

blocks.zh: EC 識別決策樹 EC Identification Logic
blocks.en: EC Identification Logic

blocks.zh:
製程參數 / 物料屬性 / 品質屬性
          ↓
是否直接影響患者安全 / 產品 CQA？
    是 → 候選 EC（需申報）
    否 → 候選 Non-EC（PQS 內管理）
          ↓（對候選 EC）
是否已有足夠科學數據支持「變更不影響 CQA」？
    有 → 可能降為 Non-EC + 申報豁免
    無 → 維持 EC 狀態，變更需先驗證後申報
blocks.en:
Process parameter / material attribute / quality attribute
          ↓
Does it directly affect patient safety / product CQAs?
    Yes → candidate EC (filing required)
    No  → candidate Non-EC (managed within PQS)
          ↓ (for candidate ECs)
Is there sufficient scientific data to support "the change does not affect CQAs"?
    Yes → may be downgraded to Non-EC + filing exemption
    No  → remains an EC; the change must be validated first and then filed

blocks.zh: 一間 CDMO 的批次製造紀錄中有 500 個製程參數。請問哪些原則決定其中哪些需要列為 EC？
blocks.en: The batch manufacturing record of a CDMO contains 500 process parameters. What principles determine which of them need to be listed as ECs?

blocks.zh: 返工過程中若必須變更某個「已申報的 EC」（例如超濾截留分子量從 30 kDa 改為 50 kDa），下一步應該如何處理？
blocks.en: If a rework requires changing an already-filed EC (for example, changing the ultrafiltration molecular weight cut-off from 30 kDa to 50 kDa), how should the next step be handled?

blocks.zh: 5.8 Post-Approval Change Management Protocols (PACMP) 上市後變更管理協議
blocks.en: 5.8 Post-Approval Change Management Protocols (PACMP)

blocks.zh: PACMP (Post-Approval Change Management Protocol，上市後變更管理協議): MAH 與監管機構預先商定的「變更框架協議」——等同於一份「預先批准的變更藍圖」。一旦 PACMP 獲批，未來按此藍圖執行的變更可享受較快的審查路徑。
blocks.en: PACMP (Post-Approval Change Management Protocol): A "change framework agreement" pre-agreed between the MAH and the regulatory authority, equivalent to a "pre-approved change blueprint". Once a PACMP is approved, future changes executed according to this blueprint can benefit from a faster review pathway.

blocks.zh: Comparability Protocol (CP，可比性協議): PACMP 的具體技術版本，描述變更後如何證明產品品質與原製程相當。必須涵蓋：分析測試計畫、接受標準、穩定性策略、免疫原性評估。
blocks.en: Comparability Protocol (CP): The specific technical version of a PACMP, describing how to demonstrate that product quality after the change is comparable to that of the original process. It must cover the analytical testing plan, acceptance criteria, stability strategy and immunogenicity assessment.

blocks.zh: 累積變更效應 (Cumulative Changes): 返工可能涉及多個製程步驟的同步調整。每一步驟單獨的風險可能低，但累積起來可能對蛋白質結構產生意外影響。CP 必須明確討論此風險。
blocks.en: Cumulative Changes: A rework may involve simultaneous adjustments to multiple process steps. The risk of each step alone may be low, but cumulatively they may have unexpected effects on protein structure. The CP must explicitly discuss this risk.

blocks.zh: PACMP 就像預先向政府申請的「施工範圍許可令」——先核定哪些類型的修繕可以在一定範圍內自行決定，哪些需要每次個別申請。拿到許可令後，在許可範圍內施工只需備案；超出範圍才需重新申請。返工的 PACMP 意義相同：預先取得框架同意，加快事件發生時的回應速度。
blocks.en: A PACMP is like a "scope-of-work permit" applied for in advance from the government: it first determines which types of repairs can be decided independently within a defined scope and which require an individual application each time. Once the permit is obtained, work within the permitted scope only needs to be filed; only work beyond the scope requires a new application. A rework PACMP has the same meaning: agreement on the framework is obtained in advance, speeding up the response when an event occurs.

blocks.zh: 免疫原性是底線： 蛋白質返工最嚴格的要求之一是免疫原性評估。任何可能導致蛋白質結構改變的步驟（pH 改變、額外過濾、熱應力）都可能影響患者抗體反應，屬於患者安全考量，優先於一切商業考量。
blocks.en: Immunogenicity is the bottom line: One of the strictest requirements for protein rework is the immunogenicity assessment. Any step that may change protein structure (pH change, additional filtration, thermal stress) may affect the patient's antibody response. This is a patient safety consideration and takes priority over all commercial considerations.

blocks.zh: CDMO 無 PACMP 時的實務對策：
blocks.en: Practical measures when the CDMO has no PACMP:

blocks.zh: 與 Sponsor 確認現有 BLA 中是否已有核准的 PACMP 或 CP——如有，CDMO 僅需在框架內執行。
blocks.en: Confirm with the Sponsor whether an approved PACMP or CP already exists in the current BLA. If so, the CDMO only needs to execute within that framework.

blocks.zh: 如無，CDMO 需協助 Sponsor 起草新的 CP，並預期 4–8 週的機構審查時間（CBE-30 路徑），或更長的 PAS 路徑。
blocks.en: If not, the CDMO needs to help the Sponsor draft a new CP, and should expect an agency review time of 4-8 weeks (CBE-30 pathway), or longer for the PAS pathway.

blocks.zh: 此準備工作應納入 Technology Transfer 計畫的 RA 里程碑。
blocks.en: This preparatory work should be included as an RA milestone in the Technology Transfer plan.

blocks.zh: PACMP 與逐案申報 (case-by-case PAS) 的主要優勢差異為何？在哪種情況下 PACMP 不適用？
blocks.en: What are the main advantages of a PACMP over case-by-case PAS filing? In what situations is a PACMP not applicable?

blocks.zh: 返工過程中必須更換一個超濾膜（UF membrane），且此膜材未列於現有 PACMP 範圍內。請問應如何處理？
blocks.en: During a rework an ultrafiltration (UF) membrane must be replaced, and the membrane material is not within the scope of the existing PACMP. How should this be handled?

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: Amaran 作為台灣 CDMO，若承接一個 US FDA 核准的單株抗體 DS 製造，且 Sponsor 在 BLA 中已建立 PACMP，你的工廠執行返工時應優先確認：①返工步驟是否在 PACMP 涵蓋的 EC 範圍內；②若不在範圍內，誰負責向 FDA 提交修訂版 PACMP（通常是 MAH/Sponsor，CDMO 提供技術數據支持）；③台灣本地批次若供應台灣市場，需同步向 TFDA 評估是否需要額外申報。
blocks.en: Suppose Amaran, as a Taiwan CDMO, takes on manufacture of a US FDA-approved monoclonal antibody DS, and the Sponsor has already established a PACMP in the BLA. When your site performs a rework, you should first confirm: (1) whether the rework steps fall within the EC scope covered by the PACMP; (2) if not, who is responsible for submitting a revised PACMP to the FDA (usually the MAH/Sponsor, with the CDMO providing supporting technical data); (3) if Taiwan-manufactured batches supply the Taiwan market, whether an additional filing to the TFDA must be evaluated in parallel.

blocks.zh: 5.9 Instabilities and Quality Concerns 不穩定性與品質疑慮
blocks.en: 5.9 Instabilities and Quality Concerns

blocks.zh: 蛋白質不穩定性的兩大類型：
blocks.en: The two major types of protein instability:

blocks.zh: 化學性不穩定 (Chemical Instability):
blocks.en: Chemical Instability:

blocks.zh: 去醯胺化 (Deamidation)：Asn/Gln 側鏈水解，影響電荷分佈
blocks.en: Deamidation: hydrolysis of Asn/Gln side chains, affecting charge distribution

blocks.zh: 氧化 (Oxidation)：Met/Trp/Cys 被氧化，影響結合活性
blocks.en: Oxidation: oxidation of Met/Trp/Cys, affecting binding activity

blocks.zh: 水解 (Hydrolysis)：肽鍵斷裂，產生碎片
blocks.en: Hydrolysis: cleavage of peptide bonds, producing fragments

blocks.zh: 物理性不穩定 (Physical Instability):
blocks.en: Physical Instability:

blocks.zh: 變性 (Denaturation)：三維結構展開，喪失活性
blocks.en: Denaturation: unfolding of the three-dimensional structure, with loss of activity

blocks.zh: 非共價聚集 (Noncovalent Aggregation)：可逆或不可逆聚集體，觸發免疫反應風險
blocks.en: Noncovalent Aggregation: reversible or irreversible aggregates, with a risk of triggering an immune response

blocks.zh: 纖維化 (Fibrillation)：有序聚集結構，高免疫原性
blocks.en: Fibrillation: ordered aggregate structures, highly immunogenic

blocks.zh: 蛋白質分子就像精密折紙藝術品——正確折疊的三維結構才有功能。返工中的額外製程步驟像是把折紙重新處理：pH 偏移是用水泡折紙（紙張膨脹變形）、高溫是烘乾（結構收縮），震盪是反覆折疊（疲勞斷裂）。每一步都有可能讓折紙永久變形而無法還原。
blocks.en: A protein molecule is like a delicate piece of origami: only the correctly folded three-dimensional structure is functional. The extra process steps in a rework are like reprocessing the origami: a pH shift is soaking the paper in water (the paper swells and deforms), high temperature is drying it (the structure shrinks), and agitation is folding it repeatedly (fatigue and breakage). Each step may permanently deform the origami so that it cannot be restored.

blocks.zh: 區分真正的不穩定 vs 分析方法干擾： 返工後若 SEC-HPLC 顯示聚集體增加，應先確認：①樣品前處理是否引入了人工聚集？②分析方法是否已驗證在此返工樣品基質中的適用性？③是否同步做了強制降解（forced degradation）對照？排除分析干擾後，才能將結果解讀為真實品質偏差。
blocks.en: Distinguishing true instability from analytical method interference: If SEC-HPLC shows an increase in aggregates after rework, first confirm: (1) Did sample preparation introduce artificial aggregation? (2) Has the analytical method been validated as suitable for the matrix of this reworked sample? (3) Was a forced degradation control run in parallel? Only after analytical interference has been excluded can the result be interpreted as a true quality deviation.

blocks.zh: Leachables & Extractables 的新興警示： PVDF 和 PES 等滅菌級過濾膜的可溶出物可能對 mAb 產生「界面活性劑效應」，加速蛋白質聚集。返工中若引入新的過濾器接觸材料，必須進行 L&E 評估——這是 §5.11 時程中「Analytical Testing (4–8 週)」的重要項目。
blocks.en: Emerging warning on Leachables & Extractables: Leachables from sterilizing-grade filter membranes such as PVDF and PES may have a "surfactant effect" on mAbs and accelerate protein aggregation. If a new filter contact material is introduced during rework, an L&E assessment must be performed. This is an important item within "Analytical Testing (4-8 weeks)" in the §5.11 timeline.

blocks.zh: 決策層級警示： 免疫原性風險 = 患者安全直接威脅 → 永遠優先於生產時程或成本考量（決策層級第一位）。
blocks.en: Decision hierarchy warning: Immunogenicity risk = a direct threat to patient safety, so it always takes priority over production schedule or cost considerations (first place in the decision hierarchy).

blocks.zh: 返工後不穩定性風險矩陣
blocks.en: Post-Rework Instability Risk Matrix

blocks.zh:
應力因子         主要風險          關鍵監控指標
──────────────────────────────────────────────
高溫（病毒滅活） 聚集、脫醯胺      SEC-HPLC、DLS
低 pH（病毒滅活） 聚集、沉澱        外觀、濁度
高離子強度（層析）聚集、蛋白質沉澱  SEC、icIEF
超濾（高濃度）    黏度、聚集         黏度計、粒徑
凍融循環          聚集、可見微粒    粒子計數、外觀
震盪              表面吸附聚集       外觀、SEC
blocks.en:
Stress factor                   Main risk                    Key monitoring parameters
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
High temperature (viral inact.) Aggregation, deamidation     SEC-HPLC, DLS
Low pH (viral inactivation)     Aggregation, precipitation   Appearance, turbidity
High ionic strength (chromat.)  Aggregation, precipitation   SEC, icIEF
Ultrafiltration (high conc.)    Viscosity, aggregation       Viscometer, particle size
Freeze-thaw cycles              Aggregation, visible particles  Particle count, appearance
Agitation                       Surface-adsorption aggregation  Appearance, SEC

blocks.zh: 返工過程中蛋白質聚集體突然增加，第一步應如何判斷是「製程導致的真實聚集」還是「分析方法偽陽性」？
blocks.en: If protein aggregates suddenly increase during a rework, what is the first step in deciding whether it is "true process-induced aggregation" or an "analytical method false positive"?

blocks.zh: 若在返工後的超濾步驟引入了一個新的 PVDF 膜，需要做哪些額外測試才能確認批次可接受？
blocks.en: If a new PVDF membrane is introduced in the ultrafiltration step after rework, what additional testing is needed to confirm that the batch is acceptable?

blocks.zh: 5.10 Roles and Communication 角色分工與溝通
blocks.en: 5.10 Roles and Communication

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts — 5.10.1 角色
blocks.en: Key Concepts: 5.10.1 Roles

blocks.zh: 返工事件的典型跨功能團隊 (Cross-Functional Team, CFT)：
blocks.en: A typical Cross-Functional Team (CFT) for a rework event:

blocks.zh: QA（品質保證）：最終決策者、變更控制負責人、偏差調查主導
blocks.en: QA (Quality Assurance): final decision maker, owner of change control, lead of the deviation investigation

blocks.zh: QC（品質控制）：額外分析測試執行、結果解讀
blocks.en: QC (Quality Control): performs additional analytical testing and interprets results

blocks.zh: MS&T / Process Science（製程科學）：返工步驟設計、小規模研究、技術評估
blocks.en: MS&T / Process Science: rework step design, small-scale studies, technical assessment

blocks.zh: RA（法規事務）：申報策略、與主管機關溝通、文件準備
blocks.en: RA (Regulatory Affairs): filing strategy, communication with authorities, document preparation

blocks.zh: MFG（製造）：執行返工操作、記錄偏差
blocks.en: MFG (Manufacturing): executes the rework operations and records deviations

blocks.zh: Supply Chain：原料可用性、排程影響、商業團隊溝通
blocks.en: Supply Chain: raw material availability, schedule impact, communication with the commercial team

blocks.zh: Sponsor（委託方）：最終策略決定、資源核准
blocks.en: Sponsor: final strategic decisions and resource approval

blocks.zh: 特別注意：TR74 明確點名合約製造商 (CMO) 與供應鏈/需求規劃團隊應納入跨部門協作——此條文直接指向 CDMO 應主動融入 Sponsor 的決策循環，而非被動等待指令。
blocks.en: Special note: TR74 explicitly names contract manufacturers (CMOs) and supply chain/demand planning teams as needing to be included in cross-functional collaboration. This provision points directly to the CDMO integrating proactively into the Sponsor's decision cycle rather than passively waiting for instructions.

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts — 5.10.2 溝通
blocks.en: Key Concepts: 5.10.2 Communication

blocks.zh: 返工溝通計畫的七要素：
blocks.en: The seven elements of a rework communication plan:

blocks.zh: 溝通目標（What）
blocks.en: Communication objectives (What)

blocks.zh: 利害關係人清單（Who）
blocks.en: Stakeholder list (Who)

blocks.zh: 溝通頻率（When）
blocks.en: Communication frequency (When)

blocks.zh: 溝通管道（How）——正式 vs 非正式
blocks.en: Communication channels (How): formal vs informal

blocks.zh: 文件追溯性（Traceability）
blocks.en: Document traceability (Traceability)

blocks.zh: 監管溝通協議（Regulatory Communication Protocol）
blocks.en: Regulatory Communication Protocol

blocks.zh: 危機溝通預案（Contingency Plan）
blocks.en: Contingency Plan

blocks.zh: 返工的跨部門溝通就像急救手術的「手術室簡報 (surgical huddle)」——開始前 5 分鐘，主刀、麻醉師、護理師、器械師各自確認分工與風險。沒有清晰的角色分工，手術就容易出錯。CDMO 的返工決策會議應比照此標準——不能只有 QA 一人講、其他人沉默。
blocks.en: Cross-functional communication for a rework is like the "surgical huddle" before emergency surgery: in the 5 minutes before starting, the surgeon, anesthesiologist, nurses and instrument technician each confirm their roles and the risks. Without clear role allocation, surgery is prone to error. A CDMO's rework decision meeting should meet the same standard: it cannot be only QA speaking while everyone else stays silent.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — CDMO 跨組織溝通挑戰
blocks.en: Key Notes: CDMO Cross-Organizational Communication Challenges

blocks.zh: 台灣 CDMO 執行返工時，溝通的複雜度高於自有產品廠：
blocks.en: When a Taiwan CDMO performs a rework, communication is more complex than at a site making its own products:

blocks.zh: 語言差異：美國 Sponsor 的技術溝通以英文為主，內部溝通以中文進行，翻譯準確性影響決策品質。
blocks.en: Language difference: Technical communication with the US Sponsor is mainly in English while internal communication is in Chinese, so translation accuracy affects decision quality.

blocks.zh: 時差：台北與美東時差 12–13 小時，緊急返工決策需建立非工作時間溝通協議（oncall protocol）。
blocks.en: Time difference: Taipei is 12-13 hours ahead of the US East Coast, so an urgent rework decision requires an out-of-hours communication protocol (on-call protocol).

blocks.zh: 授權層級：某些變更決策需 Sponsor 的 QA 或 RA VP 批准，CDMO 不能單獨決定。提前明確授權矩陣 (RACI) 可防止返工執行延誤。
blocks.en: Authority level: Some change decisions require approval from the Sponsor's QA or RA VP, and the CDMO cannot decide alone. Clarifying the authorization matrix (RACI) in advance prevents delays in rework execution.

blocks.zh: 保密協議：返工涉及 Sponsor 的 IP（製程機密），所有溝通紀錄需符合 CDA/MSA 規定。
blocks.en: Confidentiality agreement: A rework involves the Sponsor's IP (process secrets), so all communication records must comply with the CDA/MSA.

blocks.zh: 返工事件發生時，誰應該被列為「必須在 24 小時內通知」的關鍵利害關係人？請從 CDMO 角度建立優先清單。
blocks.en: When a rework event occurs, who should be listed as a key stakeholder that "must be notified within 24 hours"? Build a priority list from the CDMO perspective.

blocks.zh: 若 Sponsor 的 RA 部門與 CDMO 的 QA 部門對返工風險評估有不同意見，決策權在誰？如何解決分歧？
blocks.en: If the Sponsor's RA department and the CDMO's QA department hold different opinions on the rework risk assessment, who has the decision authority? How is the disagreement resolved?

blocks.zh: 建議在 Tech Transfer 階段即建立「返工溝通矩陣 (Rework Communication Matrix)」，明定：①事件分類標準（輕微 / 嚴重）；②各類事件的通知時限（例：嚴重 OOS 4 小時內通知 Sponsor QA Director）；③正式溝通管道（email cc 清單 + 電話備援）；④決策授權層級（哪些決策 CDMO 可自行決定，哪些需 Sponsor 批准）。此矩陣應納入 Quality Agreement (QAA) 附件。
blocks.en: It is recommended to establish a "Rework Communication Matrix" at the Tech Transfer stage, specifying: (1) event classification criteria (minor / major); (2) notification time limits for each event class (for example, a major OOS is notified to the Sponsor QA Director within 4 hours); (3) formal communication channels (email cc list + telephone backup); (4) decision authority levels (which decisions the CDMO may make on its own and which require Sponsor approval). This matrix should be included as an appendix to the Quality Agreement (QAA).

blocks.zh: 5.11 Submission & Approval Timelines 送件與核准時程
blocks.en: 5.11 Submission & Approval Timelines

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts — 申報路徑對照
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Comparison of Filing Pathways

blocks.zh: 美國 FDA 三種申報路徑（生物製品 BLA）：
blocks.en: Three US FDA filing pathways (biologics BLA):

blocks.zh: Prior Approval Supplement (PAS)：上市前需獲核准，FDA 目標審查時限 6 個月（一般）或 2 個月（急件）。適用：高風險製程變更、CQA 可能受影響。
blocks.en: Prior Approval Supplement (PAS): approval is required before implementation; the FDA review goal is 6 months (standard) or 2 months (expedited). Applies to high-risk process changes where CQAs may be affected.

blocks.zh: Changes Being Effected in 30 Days (CBE-30)：提交後 30 天可實施（FDA 如無反對）。適用：中度風險變更。
blocks.en: Changes Being Effected in 30 Days (CBE-30): may be implemented 30 days after submission (if the FDA has no objection). Applies to moderate-risk changes.

blocks.zh: Annual Report (AR)：年度彙整申報，實施前不需等待。適用：低風險、輕微變更。
blocks.en: Annual Report (AR): consolidated annual filing, with no waiting before implementation. Applies to low-risk, minor changes.

blocks.zh: 歐盟 EMA 主要路徑：
blocks.en: Main EU EMA pathways:

blocks.zh: Type II Variation（主要變更）：審查時限 60 天（有效時限），對應 FDA PAS，高風險製程變更。
blocks.en: Type II Variation (major change): review time limit of 60 days (effective), corresponding to the FDA PAS, for high-risk process changes.

blocks.zh: Type IB Variation（中度變更）：30 天通知後可實施，對應 FDA CBE-30。
blocks.en: Type IB Variation (moderate change): may be implemented after a 30-day notification, corresponding to the FDA CBE-30.

blocks.zh: Type IA (IAIN, 立即通知) / 年度評估：對應 FDA Annual Report。
blocks.en: Type IA (IAIN, immediate notification) / annual assessment: corresponds to the FDA Annual Report.

blocks.zh: 返工時程估算框架
blocks.en: Rework Timeline Estimation Framework

blocks.zh:
階段                          時間範圍
─────────────────────────────────────
1. 評估與規劃                  2–4 週
2. 製程開發與優化              4–12 週
3. 分析與穩定性測試            4–8 週
4. 放大與驗證                  8–16 週
5. 監管文件準備與送件          4–12 週
   ├─ CBE-30：送出後 30 天
   ├─ PAS：等待 6–12 個月*
   └─ EU Type II：等待 2–6 個月
6. 製造與放行                  2–6 週
─────────────────────────────────────
總計（不含監管等待）：        24–58 週
最終總時程（含 PAS 等待）：   6–18 個月
*急件 PAS 可申請加速審查 (2 個月目標)
blocks.en:
Phase                                  Time range
─────────────────────────────────────────────────
1. Assessment and planning             2-4 weeks
2. Process development and optimization  4-12 weeks
3. Analytical and stability testing    4-8 weeks
4. Scale-up and validation             8-16 weeks
5. Regulatory document preparation and submission  4-12 weeks
   ├─ CBE-30: 30 days after submission
   ├─ PAS: wait 6-12 months*
   └─ EU Type II: wait 2-6 months
6. Manufacturing and release           2-6 weeks
─────────────────────────────────────────────────
Total (excluding regulatory wait):     24-58 weeks
Overall total (including PAS wait):    6-18 months
*An urgent PAS can request expedited review (2-month target)

blocks.zh: 返工時程就像飛機緊急迫降後的「適航性恢復計畫」——工程師評估損傷（第 1 階段）→ 設計修復方案並小規模測試（第 2 階段）→ 完整結構測試（第 3 階段）→ 試飛驗證（第 4 階段）→ 向民航局申請恢復飛行許可（第 5 階段）→ 正式投入服務（第 6 階段）。跳過任何一步，民航局就不會發許可。製藥返工的監管邏輯完全相同。
blocks.en: A rework timeline is like the "airworthiness restoration plan" after an aircraft emergency landing: engineers assess the damage (phase 1), design a repair and test it at small scale (phase 2), run complete structural tests (phase 3), verify with a test flight (phase 4), apply to the aviation authority for permission to resume flying (phase 5), and formally return to service (phase 6). If any step is skipped, the aviation authority will not issue the permit. The regulatory logic of a pharmaceutical rework is exactly the same.

blocks.zh: CDMO 時程規劃的三大陷阱：
blocks.en: The three major pitfalls in CDMO timeline planning:

blocks.zh: 低估監管等待時間：若返工需 PAS（FDA）+ Type II Variation（EMA），兩個機構同時送件，平行審查仍可能需要 6–12 個月。不能假設所有市場可同步獲批。
blocks.en: Underestimating regulatory wait time: If the rework needs a PAS (FDA) + Type II Variation (EMA), even with both agencies filed at the same time, parallel review may still take 6-12 months. Do not assume that all markets can be approved simultaneously.

blocks.zh: Leachables & Extractables 測試時間：若引入新的一次性系統（Single-Use）接觸材料，L&E 研究本身可能需要 8–16 週，必須提前納入計畫。
blocks.en: Leachables & Extractables testing time: If a new single-use contact material is introduced, the L&E study itself may take 8-16 weeks and must be planned for in advance.

blocks.zh: 穩定性數據缺口：返工批次需要至少初期穩定性數據（通常 3 個月）才能支持申報文件。穩定性研究必須在最終放大驗證批完成後立即啟動。
blocks.en: Stability data gap: A reworked batch needs at least initial stability data (usually 3 months) to support the filing documents. The stability study must be started immediately after the final scale-up validation batch is completed.

blocks.zh: 一個返工案例涉及將色譜管柱樹脂從 A 品牌換成 B 品牌（相同樹脂類型，不同廠商）。在美國 FDA BLA 框架下，此變更最可能走哪一種申報路徑？理由為何？
blocks.en: A rework case involves changing a chromatography column resin from brand A to brand B (same resin type, different supplier). Under the US FDA BLA framework, which filing pathway is this change most likely to follow, and why?

blocks.zh: 若返工完成後，Sponsor 希望在 4 個月內恢復供應，你的 Project Manager 詢問「能否在監管核准前先製造批次等待放行？」請從 GMP 和監管合規角度回答此問題。
blocks.en: After the rework is completed, the Sponsor wants to resume supply within 4 months, and your Project Manager asks, "Can we manufacture batches before regulatory approval and hold them awaiting release?" Answer this question from the GMP and regulatory compliance perspective.

blocks.zh: 5.12 Quality Unit Preparedness 品質部門的預備狀態
blocks.en: 5.12 Quality Unit Preparedness

blocks.zh: 品質部門的雙重角色：
blocks.en: The dual role of the Quality Unit:

blocks.zh: ① 事前把關 (Pre-Approval Gating)： 在返工方案提交監管機構前，QU 是最終技術與法規審核的把關者——未獲 QU 批准的返工協議不得送件，更不得執行。
blocks.en: (1) Pre-Approval Gating: Before a rework plan is submitted to the regulatory authority, the QU is the final gatekeeper for technical and regulatory review. A rework protocol that has not been approved by the QU must not be submitted, much less executed.

blocks.zh: ② 執行期間監督 (During-Execution Oversight)： 返工批次的每一個關鍵步驟（pH 調整、溫度控制、過濾操作）都需 QA 現場或遠端即時監督，QC 須執行即時分析以提供決策數據。
blocks.en: (2) During-Execution Oversight: Every critical step of the reworked batch (pH adjustment, temperature control, filtration operation) requires real-time QA supervision, on site or remote, and QC must perform real-time analysis to provide decision data.

blocks.zh: QA vs QC 分工：
blocks.en: QA vs QC responsibilities:

blocks.zh: QA：系統合規性、偏差管理、批次放行決策
blocks.en: QA: system compliance, deviation management, batch release decision

blocks.zh: QC：分析測試執行、OOS 調查、方法適用性確認
blocks.en: QC: performing analytical testing, OOS investigation, confirming method suitability

blocks.zh: 品質部門的返工預備工作就像消防站的「災害應變演練」——消防員不能等到火災發生才開始學習操作消防車。返工 SOP、不符合物料隔離程序、緊急分析方法——都必須在平時演練好、文件備妥。當返工事件真正發生時，QU 的工作是「執行已訓練的程序」而非「臨時學習新技能」。
blocks.en: The Quality Unit's rework preparation is like a fire station's "disaster response drill": firefighters cannot wait until a fire breaks out to learn how to operate the fire engine. The rework SOP, the nonconforming material segregation procedure and emergency analytical methods must all be rehearsed and documented in normal times. When a rework event actually occurs, the QU's job is to "execute trained procedures" rather than "learn new skills on the spot".

blocks.zh: 「事前準備」的五個關鍵文件清單（CDMO 具體版）：
blocks.en: List of five key documents for "advance preparation" (CDMO-specific version):

blocks.zh: 返工決策矩陣 SOP：定義哪些偏差可考慮返工、哪些應直接拒絕——防止返工成為「逃避拒批的捷徑」。
blocks.en: Rework decision matrix SOP: defines which deviations may be considered for rework and which should be rejected outright, to prevent rework from becoming a "shortcut to avoid rejection".

blocks.zh: 不符合物料隔離程序：返工中間物必須與正常批次完全實體隔離，並有明確標識。
blocks.en: Nonconforming material segregation procedure: reworked intermediates must be completely physically segregated from normal batches and clearly identified.

blocks.zh: 額外分析方法清單：預先識別哪些 ECLs（延伸特性測試）可能需要用到——例如 SEC-HPLC 聚集體分析、icIEF 電荷異質性。
blocks.en: List of additional analytical methods: identify in advance which ECLs (extended characterization tests) may be needed, for example SEC-HPLC aggregate analysis and icIEF charge heterogeneity.

blocks.zh: 穩定性研究啟動標準作業：返工批次完成後，穩定性研究必須即時啟動，不得延遲。
blocks.en: Stability study initiation SOP: after the reworked batch is completed, the stability study must be started immediately without delay.

blocks.zh: Sponsor 通知程序：符合 QAA 要求的通知時限與格式，需預先建立模板。
blocks.en: Sponsor notification procedure: notification time limits and formats that meet QAA requirements, with templates prepared in advance.

blocks.zh: 返工 QU 監督檢查點
blocks.en: Rework QU Oversight Checkpoints

blocks.zh:
返工階段           QA 責任                QC 責任
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
事前（批准前）    審核返工協議           確認方法適用性
                  批准 PACMP 送件        準備額外測試方法

執行中            現場 / 遠端監督        即時分析（IPC）
                  偏差即時記錄           OOS 快速評估
                  關鍵步驟簽批           特性分析測試

執行後            批次記錄審核           穩定性樣品取樣
                  與 RA 協調送件         ECL 測試執行
                  批次放行決策           分析數據審核
blocks.en:
Rework phase        QA responsibility            QC responsibility
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Before (pre-approval) Review rework protocol       Confirm method suitability
                    Approve PACMP submission     Prepare additional test methods

During execution    On-site / remote oversight   Real-time analysis (IPC)
                    Real-time deviation recording  Rapid OOS assessment
                    Sign-off of critical steps   Characterization testing

After execution     Batch record review          Stability sample pulls
                    Coordinate submission with RA  ECL testing
                    Batch release decision       Analytical data review

blocks.zh: 如果你今天被要求評估貴廠對於一個「mAb DS 色譜步驟 OOS → 考慮返工」事件的 QU 準備度，你會優先查看哪三份文件的現況？
blocks.en: If you were asked today to assess your site's QU preparedness for an event of "mAb DS chromatography step OOS, considering rework", which three documents would you check first for their current status?

blocks.zh: 在返工執行期間，QC 發現一個中間體測試結果超出 Action Level（但未超出規格）。QA 應如何決策？是否繼續、停止或調查後再決定？
blocks.en: During rework execution, QC finds that an intermediate test result exceeds the Action Level (but not the specification). How should QA decide? Continue, stop, or investigate first and then decide?

blocks.zh: 建議每年進行一次「返工桌上演練 (Rework Table-Top Exercise)」——模擬一個典型 mAb DS 批次的 OOS 場景，讓 QA、QC、MS&T、RA、MFG 各部門代表走過完整的決策流程。桌上演練的輸出是一份「準備度缺口評估報告」，用以識別文件缺失、人員能力不足、或跨部門溝通盲點，並轉化為 CAPA。這是最具成本效益的返工準備投資。
blocks.en: It is recommended to hold a "Rework Table-Top Exercise" once a year, simulating an OOS scenario in a typical mAb DS batch and having representatives from QA, QC, MS&T, RA and MFG walk through the complete decision process. The output of the table-top exercise is a "preparedness gap assessment report" used to identify missing documents, insufficient personnel capability or cross-functional communication blind spots, which are then converted into CAPA. This is the most cost-effective investment in rework preparedness.

blocks.zh: 5.13 Conclusions 結論
blocks.en: 5.13 Conclusions

blocks.zh: 緊急情況下的監管彈性 (Regulatory Flexibility in Emergencies): COVID-19 期間，FDA 和 EMA 均發布了緊急指南，允許在特定條件下對製程進行例外偏差——但這並非「無需申報」的免責，而是「加速審查 + 後續補件」的程序調整。監管彈性的前提仍是患者安全不受損。
blocks.en: Regulatory Flexibility in Emergencies: During COVID-19, the FDA and EMA both issued emergency guidance allowing exceptional deviations in the process under specific conditions. This was not an exemption from "no filing required" but a procedural adjustment of "expedited review + subsequent supplementary submission". The precondition for regulatory flexibility remains that patient safety is not compromised.

blocks.zh: 「絕不視為例行程序」的核心意涵： 返工從本質上是一個例外事件 (exception event)。若某工廠每批次都在考慮返工，這已不是返工問題，而是根本製程能力不足的系統性問題——必須走 CAPA，從根因改善，而非重複申請返工核准。
blocks.en: The core meaning of "never regard as routine": A rework is by nature an exception event. If a site is considering a rework for every batch, this is no longer a rework problem but a systemic problem of inadequate fundamental process capability. It must go through CAPA to improve from the root cause, rather than repeatedly applying for rework approval.

blocks.zh: 返工就像外科手術中的「緊急處置方案」——有時必要，但絕不應是計劃外手術的常態。若一個醫院每週都要對同一類手術採取「緊急處置」，問題不在緊急處置程序，而在術前評估和手術規範本身。製藥返工的哲學完全相同：準備好應對，但以避免為目標。
blocks.en: A rework is like an "emergency treatment plan" in surgery: sometimes necessary, but it should never be the norm for unplanned surgery. If a hospital has to resort to "emergency treatment" for the same type of surgery every week, the problem is not the emergency procedure but the preoperative assessment and the surgical standards themselves. The philosophy of pharmaceutical rework is exactly the same: be prepared to respond, but aim to avoid it.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — 積極主動的心態 (Proactive Mindset)
blocks.en: Key Notes: Proactive Mindset

blocks.zh: TR74 §5.13 傳遞的核心訊息——預防勝於應對：
blocks.en: The core message of TR74 §5.13: prevention is better than response:

blocks.zh: 提前建立 PACMP：不要等到 OOS 發生才起草——這就像只有在火災發生時才去申請消防許可。
blocks.en: Establish the PACMP in advance: Do not wait until an OOS occurs to draft it. That would be like applying for a fire permit only after a fire breaks out.

blocks.zh: 定期 EC 審查：每年與 Sponsor 和 RA 確認現有 EC 清單是否反映當前製程實際狀況。
blocks.en: Periodic EC review: Each year, confirm with the Sponsor and RA that the current EC list reflects the actual state of the current process.

blocks.zh: 主動接觸主管機關：TR74 明確建議「proactively engage with regulatory authorities」——在問題擴大前主動諮詢，比被動應對更有效。對台灣 CDMO 而言，這意味著與 Sponsor 共同主動尋求 FDA/EMA 的非正式溝通 (Type C meeting, 科學諮詢)。
blocks.en: Proactively engage with regulatory authorities: TR74 explicitly recommends "proactively engage with regulatory authorities". Consulting before a problem grows is more effective than reacting passively. For a Taiwan CDMO, this means working with the Sponsor to proactively seek informal communication with the FDA/EMA (Type C meeting, scientific advice).

blocks.zh: CAPA 文化優先：每一次返工事件結束後，根本原因分析和 CAPA 計畫應視為強制性輸出，而非可選項。防止重複發生是最有效的長期成本控制。
blocks.en: CAPA culture first: After every rework event, root cause analysis and a CAPA plan should be regarded as mandatory outputs, not optional ones. Preventing recurrence is the most effective long-term cost control.

blocks.zh: Section 5 Part B 總結 — 決策層級最終確認
blocks.en: Section 5 Part B Summary: Final Confirmation of the Decision Hierarchy

blocks.zh: 回顧 Section 5 (Part B) 整章，每一個主題都指向相同的核心決策框架：
blocks.en: Looking back over the whole of Section 5 (Part B), every topic points to the same core decision framework:

blocks.zh: 無菌保證 (Sterility) > CQA 保護 (Patient Safety) > 商業彈性 (Business)
blocks.en: Sterility assurance (Sterility) > CQA protection (Patient Safety) > commercial flexibility (Business)

blocks.zh: §5.6–5.8：即使有 PACMP 和 EC 彈性，絕不以降低 CQA 標準換取申報速度。
blocks.en: §5.6-5.8: Even with PACMP and EC flexibility, never lower CQA standards in exchange for filing speed.

blocks.zh: §5.9：蛋白質不穩定和免疫原性風險是患者安全的直接威脅，優先於一切。
blocks.en: §5.9: Protein instability and immunogenicity risk are direct threats to patient safety and take priority over everything.

blocks.zh: §5.10：溝通透明是維護患者安全的信任基礎，不得因商業壓力壓縮。
blocks.en: §5.10: Transparent communication is the foundation of trust in safeguarding patient safety and must not be compressed by commercial pressure.

blocks.zh: §5.11–5.12：時程再緊，也不能跳過驗證和 QU 把關。
blocks.en: §5.11-5.12: However tight the schedule, validation and QU gatekeeping cannot be skipped.

blocks.zh: §5.13：緊急彈性是工具，不是漏洞——患者安全永遠不妥協。
blocks.en: §5.13: Emergency flexibility is a tool, not a loophole. Patient safety is never compromised.

blocks.zh: 你的工廠在過去 12 個月內對同一個 DS 製程發生了 3 次返工。Top Management 認為這是正常的「製程調整」。你作為 QA Manager 應如何回應，並採取哪些具體行動？
blocks.en: Your site has had 3 reworks of the same DS process in the past 12 months. Top Management considers this normal "process adjustment". As QA Manager, how should you respond, and what specific actions would you take?

blocks.zh: 台灣發生重大地震，某 mAb DS 批次因停電導致冷鏈中斷，品質狀況不確定。Sponsor 要求 CDMO 立即評估是否可以「緊急返工」以避免藥品短缺。第一步應如何處理，而不是直接開始返工？
blocks.en: A major earthquake occurs in Taiwan, and a power outage interrupts the cold chain for a mAb DS batch, leaving its quality status uncertain. The Sponsor asks the CDMO to immediately evaluate whether an "emergency rework" can be performed to avoid a drug shortage. What should the first step be, rather than starting the rework directly?

blocks.zh: Section 5 Part B 重點回顧
blocks.en: Section 5 Part B Key Takeaways

blocks.zh: PAC 六大決策維度（§5.6）：Table 5.6-1 提供了從定義範圍到執行實施的完整框架——每一個返工案例都應能在此框架中找到對應位置。
blocks.en: The six PAC decision dimensions (§5.6): Table 5.6-1 provides a complete framework from defining the scope to implementation. Every rework case should be able to find its corresponding place in this framework.

blocks.zh: ICH Q12 的 EC 革命（§5.7）：Established Conditions 的建立是降低監管申報負擔的關鍵前提。若 BLA 尚未建立 EC，所有重大返工預設走 PAS 路徑。
blocks.en: The EC revolution of ICH Q12 (§5.7): Establishing Established Conditions is the key prerequisite for reducing the regulatory filing burden. If the BLA has no ECs established, all significant reworks default to the PAS pathway.

blocks.zh: PACMP = 預先取得的授權（§5.8）：一份事前獲批的 PACMP 在返工事件發生時可節省數月時間——這是最有價值的 RA 預防性投資。Comparability Protocol 必須覆蓋免疫原性評估。
blocks.en: PACMP = authorization obtained in advance (§5.8): A PACMP approved in advance can save months when a rework event occurs. This is the most valuable preventive RA investment. The Comparability Protocol must cover immunogenicity assessment.

blocks.zh: 蛋白質不穩定十大風險因子（§5.9）：從濃度/黏度到 Leachables & Extractables，每一個返工新步驟都可能引入新的應力——必須用適當的分析工具預先評估。
blocks.en: The ten major risk factors for protein instability (§5.9): From concentration/viscosity to Leachables & Extractables, every new rework step may introduce new stress, which must be assessed in advance with appropriate analytical tools.

blocks.zh: CDMO 的跨組織溝通挑戰（§5.10）：返工不是 CDMO 的內部事務——Sponsor、監管機構、供應鏈都是必要利害關係人。溝通矩陣和 RACI 應寫入 Quality Agreement。
blocks.en: CDMO cross-organizational communication challenges (§5.10): A rework is not an internal matter for the CDMO: the Sponsor, regulatory authorities and supply chain are all necessary stakeholders. The communication matrix and RACI should be written into the Quality Agreement.

blocks.zh: 6–12 個月的現實時程（§5.11）：PAS 等待期可能長達 12 個月；L&E 研究可能額外增加 8–16 週。早期規劃、早期送件是縮短總時程的唯一方法。
blocks.en: The realistic 6-12 month timeline (§5.11): The PAS waiting period can be as long as 12 months, and the L&E study may add 8-16 weeks. Early planning and early submission are the only way to shorten the total timeline.

blocks.zh: 品質部門雙重角色（§5.12）：QU 既是事前把關者（不批准就不送件），也是執行期間的監督者。返工 SOP、隔離程序、額外分析方法都需在平時準備好。
blocks.en: The dual role of the Quality Unit (§5.12): The QU is both the pre-approval gatekeeper (no approval, no submission) and the supervisor during execution. The rework SOP, segregation procedure and additional analytical methods must all be prepared in normal times.

blocks.zh: 積極主動的心態（§5.13）：返工應對是最後一道防線；預防——通過健全的製程驗證、EC 建立和 PACMP——才是正道。每一次返工事件必須以 CAPA 收尾，防止重複發生。
blocks.en: Proactive mindset (§5.13): Rework response is the last line of defense; prevention, through sound process validation, EC establishment and PACMP, is the right path. Every rework event must end with a CAPA to prevent recurrence.
